text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Panel composition alone is almost worthless as evidence. Panels are assembled from whoever holds the relevant roles; four women no more implies bias than four men would. Leading with it will read as a grievance and undermine the one complaint you actually have a solid footing on: two weeks of silence on a reasonable request for written feedback.

Also consider that a group-head role isn't won on years or degrees. Client relationships, business development and people management often outweigh design depth — her eight years may simply have fit the brief better.

Chase the feedback in writing, politely, with a deadline. If the stated reasons turn out to be incoherent or shift, revisit then.
